criteria.en: Readable hierarchy; no giant text walls
criteria.zh: 层级清楚，没有巨大文字墙

criteria.en: Technical details are collapsed by default
Method visuals and specialist entry points remain readable
criteria.zh: 方法视觉与专业入口可读

criteria.en: Cross-Perspective is readable rather than raw JSON
criteria.zh: 跨视角可读，不是 JSON 数据墙

criteria.en: Current Reality is clearly distinguished from method interpretation
criteria.zh: 当前现实与方法解释清楚区分

criteria.en: Narrative preview is attractive and understandable
criteria.zh: Narrative 预览具有吸引力且易懂

criteria.en: Paid Narrative is readable on Web / Print / PDF
criteria.zh: 付费 Narrative 在 Web／Print／PDF 上可读

criteria.en: The customer experience is not governance-first
criteria.zh: 客户体验不是治理术语优先

criteria.en: Profile source-class labels / Quick vs Full / visual separation are clear when present
criteria.zh: Profile 来源类别、Quick/Full 与视觉区分清楚

criteria.en: Person-B identity / unknown-time / relationship focus are clear when present
criteria.zh: Person B 身份、未知时间与关系焦点清楚
